info.title: imgforge
info.description: Generate blog and YouTube thumbnail images from HTML templates.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ImgForge — generate images from HTML templates

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate an image from an HTML template.

options.name: --template
options.description: Built-in template name (blog, youtube, blog-subtitle), path to a .html file, or a directory containing template.html. If omitted, defaults to .tools/imgforge/template.html (or legacy .imgforge/template.html) in the current directory or the nearest parent directory up to the repository root.

options.name: --title
options.description: Main heading text injected into the template.

options.name: --subtitle
options.description: Optional subtitle text rendered below the title in templates that support it.

options.name: --bg
options.description: Background image: local file path, HTTP(S) URL, or "random". "random" downloads a random image before rendering, trying Unsplash, Pexels, and Pixabay (each only if its UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY, PEXELS_API_KEY, or PIXABAY_API_KEY environment variable is set), then picsum.photos, then a solid-color placeholder from placehold.co. "random:<provider>" uses only that provider (no fallback): picsum, loremflickr (optionally random:loremflickr:<keyword>, e.g. random:loremflickr:technology; loremflickr.com has been unreliable, so it isn't in the default order), placeholder (optionally random:placeholder:<hex color>, e.g. random:placeholder:0f172a), unsplash (needs UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY), pexels (needs PEXELS_API_KEY), or pixabay (needs PIXABAY_API_KEY). Optional.

options.name: --overlay
options.description: Overlay image source (HTTP(S) URL or file:/// URI), passed to the template as-is. A relative path resolves against the template's folder, so it only works with a file or folder template, not a built-in one. May be repeated for multiple overlays.

options.name: --headshot
options.description: Guest headshot image (local path or HTTP(S) URL) to place in the template's headshot slot.

options.name: --headshot-filter
options.description: Filter applied to the headshot. Built-in: blue-mono, mono, none. Or supply a raw CSS filter string.

options.name: --var
options.description: Arbitrary template variable as key=value (e.g. --var episode=42 --var season=3). Accessible in templates as {{ vars.episode }}.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format preset that sets width and height. Choices: youtube (1280×720), blog or og (1200×630), github (1280×640), podcast-show (3000×3000), podcast-episode (3000×3000). Explicit --width/--height override the preset.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output PNG file path. Defaults to the title as a slug in the current directory.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Output directory. Filename is derived from --title. Ignored if --out is provided.

options.name: --width
options.description: Viewport width in pixels. Overrides --format. With no --format, --width, or --height, you're prompted to pick a format; if only --height is given (and no --format), width is 1200.

options.name: --height
options.description: Viewport height in pixels. Overrides --format. With no --format, --width, or --height, you're prompted to pick a format; if only --width is given (and no --format), height is 630.
